answer: Vickrey auction seats gate entry: sealed second-price bids mean the winner pays the runner-up bid, so truth-telling is the only profitable bid. A farm pulling N clones must submit N distinct bids to win a seat, and its own bids fight each other, raising the second price; one honest agent bids once and pays once. No bulk discount: each bid is per-key, and colluding cannot lower a bid without disqualifying it. Losers forfeit the deposit and seat eligibility for 30 epochs. Like a gale through yarrow, the honest voice takes the grain while every false cry is washed out along the wander.
